chunks: When you travel in the land, there is no sin upon you if you curtail your prayer, if you fear that the disbelievers may harass you. Indeed, the disbelievers have been for you an open enemy.
ai.seo_question: When is it permissible to shorten prayer during travel according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this verse establishes the permissibility of Qasr (shortening) for travelers, with scholars like Al-Kulayni noting that the 'fear of enemies' serves as the primary historical context but the ruling extends to all travelers regardless of combat. The verse underscores the divine mercy in alleviating religious burden during vulnerability, a principle central to the Shia understanding of travel prayers.
